original_test_intent: Obtain the selected BMC's current global enable state over the OOB path and report the standard event-buffer, interrupt and SEL-logging flags while retaining the entire raw byte for implementation-owned-bit audit.
original_method: The Master has no method. A safe candidate is standard Application Get BMC Global Enables 0x06/0x2f with no request data, successful completion and one response-data byte; this candidate does not rewrite the TBD Master text.
manual_activity: Engineer approves the decoder's standard-versus-OEM bit policy and supplies expected values only if project comparison is required; no interactive DUT action is inherent.
required_inputs: Applicable Get BMC Global Enables response schema
Opaque handling policy for reserved/OEM positions
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or other logs
Require successful completion and exactly one data byte
Do not issue Set Global Enables or remediation
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC target and protected session
Issue one bounded Get BMC Global Enables request
Store the raw byte and decode supported standard flags
Optionally compare against an approved project profile
engineer_actions: Provide an Expected profile when the project requires conformance rather than inventory
Investigate disabled or contradictory flags separately

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek supplied no command because the source is TBD. The standard 0x06/0x2f read is identifiable from the exact title and is safe only as an explicitly additive project method.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x2f`, demand exactly one response-data byte, and retain raw plus decoded forms without any setter.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 timing metadata remain unchanged; no target enable values are assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a decoder that reports bit position, standard name/support state and raw value while displaying reserved/OEM positions without assigning semantics.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Provides a bounded read candidate and evidence contract for a Master row with no procedure, without manufacturing acceptance values.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The candidate establishes current-state retrieval; it does not test changing the register or prove downstream message/interrupt delivery behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct byte can still be misreported if implementation-owned bits are labeled as standard or if a different BMC target is queried.

project_override_considerations: A vendor CLI or Redfish property may supplement the raw response, but equivalence requires a documented one-to-one mapping; it cannot silently replace the named IPMI read.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/OOB identity and tool/decoder versions
Raw 0x06/0x2f request/response, completion and one-byte length check
Full raw byte with decoded standard enable flags
Reserved/OEM positions retained as opaque values
Optional comparison with approved project Expected
Proof no configuration, logs, BMC or host power changed

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria are absent, not mutually contradictory. The title provides a recognizable read operation while Expected remains unspecified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and evidence boundary are deterministic. Target, decoder and optional Expected are ordinary project bindings, so the static review is not permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Converts an undifferentiated TBD refusal into a safe read-only candidate with exact framing, full-byte evidence, opaque OEM handling and a strict separation from the companion setter.
independent_technical_reasoning: The response is compact but semantically mixed: a single byte may contain standardized control flags and implementation-owned positions. Dropping the unknown positions loses evidence, while inventing labels for them creates false capability claims. Preserving the byte and decoding only authoritative standard bits makes the read both reproducible and non-destructive despite the absent Master procedure.
